bmc_host.description: IP address or hostname of the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC).

bmc_interface.description: IPMI interface type to use. Common values: 'lan', 'lanplus' (for RMCP+), 'kcs' (kernel channel interface), 'serial' (for serial over LAN).

bmc_username.description: Username for BMC authentication. Avoid hardcoding in production; consider using IPMI_PASSPHRASE_FILE instead.

bmc_password.description: Password for BMC authentication. For security, leave blank and use IPMI_PASSPHRASE_FILE. Required if no passphrase file is used.

session_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a response from the BMC before timing out.

retransmit_retries.description: Number of times to retransmit a request before aborting.

enable_encryption.description: Enable or disable payload encryption for LAN Plus (RMCP+) sessions. Recommended for security.

auth_type.description: Authentication algorithm to use. Options: 'none', 'md2', 'md5', 'straight', 'oem'. MD5 is recommended for most cases.

serial_device.description: Serial device path (e.g., /dev/ttyS0). Only used when interface is 'serial'.

serial_baud.description: Serial baud rate. Only used when interface is 'serial'. Common values: 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600, 115200.

cipher_suites.description: List of allowed cipher suite IDs for IPMI v2.0 RMCP+ encryption. Each integer corresponds to a specific cipher. Common: [0]=null, [1]=aes-cbc-128, [2]=aes-cbc-128-icv, etc.

bmc_realm.description: Optional realm string for RAKP authentication (IPMI 2.0). Leave blank for default.

bmc_mac.description: Optional MAC address of the BMC LAN interface. Needed for certain OEM boot options.

extra_bcms.description: List of additional BMCs to configure (e.g., for redundant BMCs or multiple chassis). Each entry is an object.

host.description: IP or hostname of this BMC.

password.description: Password for this BMC. Prefer passphrase files in production.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this BMC entry.

index.description: Numeric index suffix for config variables (e.g., IPMI_HOST_1). Must be unique per BMC.
